narr: With a moist airmass in place over the region, afternoon pulse thunderstorms developed across southwestern Missouri producing localized wind damage and flooding. Significant flooding occurred in eastern Greene County where between 3 and 6 inches of rain fall over a less than 6 hour period as persistent slow moving storms developed over the county. During the period, some locations saw in excess of an inch of rain in a 15 minute period.
ev: Water rescue reported at Glenstone and Commercial Streets. Multiple other flooding reports also received on National and Commercial Streets.
Between 3 and 4 feet of water was reported over Ker Road near the Cracker Barrel restaurant.
A water rescue occurred near the intersection of Jean and Packer Road. No injuries occurred.
Water was reported to be near waist deep at apartments near Lone Pine and Rockhurst Roads.
